result:
All 14 queries ran against the files and gave sensible answers. I checked the answers for plausibility only, not against an independent calculation.

- **W1:** returns the four users `Anna Weber`, `Boris Klein`, `Elena Rossi` and `Hugo Baas`.
- **W2:** gives `199.87`.
- **W3:** counts acme 3, initech 2, globex 1 and umbrella 1.
- **W4:** returns `axios`, `eslint`, `express`, `jest` and `zod`.
- **W5:** counts maria 3, unassigned 2 and ivan 1.
- **W6:** returns `bug`, `ci`, `feature`, `p1`, `perf` and `ui`.
- **W7:** counts db 2, api 2 and auth 1.
- **W8:** gives `192`.
- **W9:** gives eng 5067, sales 4200 and ops 3800.
- **W10:** returns `Alice`, `Erin` and `Bob`.
- **W11:** returns host, port, name and pool.size with their string values.
- **W12:** gives `3`.
- **W13:** returns P5 at 300, P4 at 240 and P6 at 237.
- **W14:** counts example.com 2, test.org 3 and demo.net 1.

W3, W5, W7, W9 and W11 print their keys as keywords such as `:acme`. A key containing a dot, like `pool.size`, prints quoted as `:"pool.size"`. In W4 the package names are converted to strings.

W1: get /data/users | filter ~(allOf (get /active | eq true) ~(query /address/city "" | lower | eq "berlin")) | map /name | sort
W2: filter ~(get /status | eq "paid") | map ~(get /items | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
W3: filter ~(get /status | ne "cancelled") | groupBy /customer | map ~(count)
W4: get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys) | flat | map ~(toString) | distinct | sort
W5: filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | map ~(query /assignee/login "unassigned") | groupBy | map ~(count)
W6: filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | map ~(query /labels []) | flat | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort
W7: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy /2 | map ~(count)
W8: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /2 | eq "api") | map ~(last | match #"took=(\d+)ms" | get /1 | toNumber) | avg | round 1
W9: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(get /2 | ne "") | map ~(get {:dept /1 :salary ~(get /2 | toNumber)}) | groupBy /dept | map ~(map /salary | avg | round)
W10: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(get /2 | ne "") | map ~(get {:name /0 :salary ~(get /2 | toNumber)}) | sort ~(get [~(get /salary | desc) /name]) | take 3 | map /name
W11: lines | filter ~(startsWith "db.") | map ~(split "=" | get [~(get /0 | drop 3 | toKeyword) /1]) | toMap
W12: filter ~(get /type | eq "click") | map ~(query /payload/user/id null) | filter ~(ne null) | distinct | count
W13: filter ~(get /stock | type | eq ::number) | filter ~(get /stock | gt 0) | map ~(get {:sku /sku :value ~(mulOf /price /stock | round 2)}) | sort ~(get /value | desc) | take 3
W14: "alice@Example.com, Bob@example.com, carol@test.org, ALICE@example.com, dave@test.org, erin@Test.org, bob@EXAMPLE.com, frank@demo.net" | split "," | map ~(trim | lower) | distinct | groupBy ~(split "@" | last) | map ~(count)
